question: What rumor did you start at school that got completely out of hand?
story: In sixth grade I convinced my entire school that our principal used to be an astronaut, and it ended up printed in the yearbook. It started as one sentence at a lunch table. I said he had a NASA photo in his office. He did have a photo. It was a poster of the moon. By Thursday, kids were asking him about zero gravity in the hallway. He never confirmed it. He also never denied it, which I now understand was the funniest possible choice a grown man could make. The rumor grew arms. Someone said he trained with a shuttle crew. Someone said he gave it all up for education. Here is the part that broke me. The yearbook staff ran a farewell page that year calling him our very own man of the stars. He signed my copy. Under his name he wrote, keep looking up. He knew. He absolutely knew.
